notes: PRRI American Values Survey, distributed by ARDA. Reviewed coverage: immigration 2018–2024, marriage 2023–2024, and abortion legality 2019–2021 and 2023–2024. Valid answers use original annual full-sample weights; missing responses excluded. Abortion 2022 is deferred because its weighted distribution does not reproduce a published topline. Other acquired questions remain unreviewed.

deferred.reason: Weighted illegal-in-most-cases percentage is 28.427%, versus published 29%; exceeds the unchanged 0.51 percentage-point tolerance. Excluding two system-missing responses from the denominator still does not reproduce 29%. Do not substitute published totals for microdata or infer the reason.
